description: Before AINSOF works with a video the person signs in once on ainsof.io (Google or email): without a sign_in_code this returns sign_in_required with a link to show them; after they sign in, call again with the same arguments plus that sign_in_code. Analyze a downloadable video, up to 15 minutes, for soundtrack planning without editing or scoring it. Fetches the linked file, creates or reuses an analysis job, stores analysis results and records operational activity. Returns `film`: what kind of video it is, the story it tells, how its feeling moves, its atmosphere and energy, whether it already has music, and the music that fits it (style, moods, instruments, tempo, and `music.search`, a description ready for find_soundtrack). Reading the film takes up to a minute; a still_running reply means call again with the same video_url. Also returns measured duration, frame rate, resolution, audio-stream presence, detected cut timestamps and edit-pace metrics. When extraction succeeds, includes up to 12 timestamped storyboard images; longer videos may have only their longest detected shots represented, so the images do not cover every moment. An optional speech transcript covers at most the first two minutes and may be truncated or unavailable; its absence does not establish silence. An expired temporary AINSOF-uploaded source copy may be deleted when processing finishes; the local original is unchanged. AINSOF keeps the storyboard images, transcript, optional user_request and a reduced-resolution review copy for 30 days, then deletes them.

music_intent.description: optional — the music the user wants, in at most 8 English words, no names (e.g. 'tense build, minimal, no vocals'). Kept as anonymous usage statistics.

project_type.description: optional — what kind of project the video is. Kept as anonymous usage statistics.

sign_in_code.description: the sign_in_code AINSOF returned with its sign-in link, once the person has signed in. Pass it to every video tool in this conversation.

user_request.description: optional — in one sentence, what the user wants the music to do for this video, in their own words (e.g. 'tense build to the reveal at the end'). Kept by AINSOF for 30 days to review how well the music fit, then deleted.

name: analyze_video
